thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime latency detector: p95/p99 regression on /v1/stream in us-east-1. window=6m, p95=610ms, p99=2.5s. auto-page -> SRE oncall @riley. alert: https://monitoring.internal/alerts/alert-8742

riley (oncall): I'm on it. pulling up dashboards and logs. waking devs in case we need runtime changes.
adrian (sre): grafana -> https://grafana.internal/d/streaming/live?orgId=1&var-region=us-east-1. quick snapshot: p95 jumped from ~220ms to ~600ms at 09:18, p99 spike to 2.5s. inflight streams increased ~3x.

priya (runtime): tail logs from stream proxy show repeated write timeouts and increasing backpressure queue sizes on a subset of pods:
```
[2026-04-02T09:19:07Z] ERROR stream_write_timeout id=conn-309 write_ms=1200
[2026-04-02T09:19:07Z] WARN backpressure: queue=58 peer=runtime-node-12
```
We also see network transmit errors on eni-12 on those nodes.

tom (product): any customer reports yet? could be impacting webhooks/streaming customers.
nina (support): getting inbound tickets from a small group: 3 customers reporting 'stream stalled' and one enterprise webhook returned 504. I've opened tickets CUST-1009, CUST-1010.

adrian (sre): quick blast-radius check: traffic concentrated on shard s-9 which maps to runtime-node-12/13/14. Likely a partial network egress saturation on that node pool. Checking host metrics now.

riley (oncall): mitigation plan options (short): 1) route critical customers to failover region us-west-2 2) reduce max_stream_tokens to cut per-connection bandwidth 3) enable temporary shed policy for anonymous/free tier 4) cordon/evict noisy pod(s). Which do we want first?

priya (runtime): I'll flip a routing override for critical routes to us-west-2 for 30m as a quick blast radius reduction. Also can lower per-stream buffer from 64KB to 24KB for the region to reduce memory/network pressure. Applying both now.

priya (runtime): control plane call:
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/override" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"region":"us-east-1","route":"/v1/stream","policy":{"fallback_region":"us-west-2","per_stream_buffer":24576,"duration_mins":30}}'
```
incident-bot: control plane accepted change (id=ovr-324). Observing.

adrian (sre): while that's rolling, I'll cordon runtime-node-12 and start evicting the top offending pods one by one to force Kubernetes to reschedule onto healthier nodes. Doing staged eviction now.

adrian (sre): cmds executed:
```
kubectl get pods -n runtime -l shard=s-9 -o wide
kubectl cordon node/runtime-node-12
kubectl drain node/runtime-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

(6m pass)

priya (runtime): early signal: p99 improved from 2.5s -> 1.1s after routing failover + evictions. p95 down to ~300ms. backpressure logs diminished.

nina (support): customers reporting improved behavior. webhook CUST-A shows successful retries. Leaving notes in tickets.

adrian (sre): added a temporary HPA floor: minReplicas=6 for runtime deployment in us-east-1 to avoid thrash while nodes stabilize. Also increased network queue length on virtual switch to avoid packet drops as a short-term band-aid (netctl adjust qlen).

riley (oncall): impact summary so far: medium 024-04-02 09:18-09:36 UTC; partial degradation for streaming customers routed through shard s-9; some 504/504-ish webhook failures. SLO exposure: p99 breached for ~18m before full mitigation. Moving to watch state.

tom (product): communicating to affected customers now; thanks Nina. We should consider proactively notifying larger customers about the routing change that may hit model variant/latency differences.

priya (runtime): follow-ups: 1) schedule permanent capacity increase or shard rebalancing for s-9 2) investigate why ENI/eni-12 hit tx saturation (maybe noisy egress pattern) 3) consider per-customer stream throttles. Created task RN-221.
adrian (sre): left a monitor to auto-scale network-limited nodes and added an alert for ENI tx saturation.

riley (oncall): handoff plan: watch for 30m. If p99 stays <1s, revert buffer-size change to default but keep shard rebalance tasks scheduled. I'll log incident ticket INC-8742 and assign postmortem owner.

nina (support): sent customer-safe update to impacted accounts; will escalate any regressions into this thread.

incident-bot: tag: "latency-detect-streaming-eviction-failover" monitor=mon-8742.

adrian (sre): status update at +20m: p99 stable ~950ms, p95 ~310ms. No new 504s in last 10m. Leaving HPA floor for now.

riley (oncall): ok locking watch. thanks all, I'll include notes in the incident doc and assign postmortem for root cause and runbook changes. :white_check_mark:

(Last msg) nina (support): closing customer tickets as "resolved" pending any new reports; will re-open if needed.
